Retrieved September 25, 2026 from the companies' own websites or their linked asset CDNs. Used to identify the employers in this independent directory; trademarks remain with their respective owners. These assets are not covered by any project code license.

- Capital One: https://tbcdn.talentbrew.com/company/234/gst_v1_0/img/logo-capital-one.svg — linked by https://www.capitalonecareers.com/
- GE Appliances: https://cdn11.bigcommerce.com/s-ikiuocf6r8/stencil/e23354f0-5320-013e-b9b0-369dcb758b06/e/48905c60-d5a8-013c-b677-12dfefb50227/img/ge-logo-blue.svg — linked by https://geappliancesco.com/
- Bell: https://cdn.phenompeople.com/CareerConnectResources/pp/BECACA/en_ca/desktop/assets/images/h/apple-touch-icon.png — linked by https://jobs.bell.ca/ca/en/
- Siemens: https://www.siemens.com/img/favicon.svg — linked by https://www.siemens.com/en-us/
- Shell: https://www.shell.us/etc.clientlibs/amidala/clientlibs/theme-base/resources/favicon/favicon.svg — linked by https://www.shell.us/

Assets are served locally. An unknown employer or failed image load omits the logo box instead of showing initials or a broken image.
